bluf: Kaizen is a London digital PR, SEO and social agency founded in 2013, with a Manchester creative hub, selling discoverability on Google, TikTok and ChatGPT under a trademarked Search-Verse framing to a mixed book. The record shows it moving into AI search with a GEO / AI Search page, prompt bank tracking and GEO and LLM masterclasses, including a London roundtable on 29 September 2026, and a leadership handover to Managing Director Kristi Hoyle. Horus reads Favored at 12.2; Monsoon reads Breeze at 54.6. What a rival should know: it sells AI visibility with no llms.txt and no audited product, while 13 of its 22 clients carry a coded need.
doing:
The positioning line, an AI enabled search, digital PR and social agency making brands discoverable on Google, TikTok and ChatGPT, their whole Search-Verse, decodes as a digital PR shop that has bolted search and short form social onto its link earning engine. The headline claim is two flagship cases: digital PR lifting Reebok's generic rankings across markets, and 942% LLM traffic growth for Mogo Farm.

The sold mix has three lead lines at score 3. Content & Digital PR: the title leads with Digital PR, the about page calls it an early DPR pioneer, and 24 of 39 listed cases are PR. Creator & Influencer: the title bills it a TikTok agency, Social is a core service, and seven social cases include Moonpig influencers. SEO: title and meta lead with search, with SEO cases for Aqua, Capital on Tap, Vonage and Aion Bank. AI Search / GEO scores 2 on a GEO / AI Search page selling prompt banks, multi model tracking and fan out analysis. Paid Search and Paid Social score 1; data and measurement, CRM, web, CRO, local, programmatic and retail media score 0. Breadth is 6. The proprietary asset is the trademarked Search-Verse framing; the record lists no partners.

Its AI posture is the most developed line after PR: GEO and AI search tracking via prompt banks across LLMs, a proprietary AI tool suite, and GEO and LLM masterclass events, including an in person London roundtable on 29 September 2026. The Horus P1 read is still partial: no audited AI visibility product shows.

The dated record is thin: one undated leadership move, Managing Director Kristi Hoyle now leading the agency founder Pete Campbell started; the about page dates its DPR pioneer status to 2018.

The record lists no pricing model. Conspicuously absent for an agency selling search and AI tracking: any data and measurement line, and any own publishing cadence the compile could measure.
clients:
The client type is mixed; verticals listed are fintech and financial services, iGaming, travel, property, beauty, education, retail and ecommerce, B2B SaaS and automotive; home market London.

The record lists 22 clients, all on case studies, and 13 carry an observed need. PR, reputation and content, N12: Reebok (regional data for coverage across the French market), Betway (building visibility through strategic digital PR coverage), SumUp (spotlighting small businesses through international PR campaigns) and Starling Bank (a travel campaign that landed worldwide coverage), the last two also coded N2, paid performance. Organic demand, N1: Aqua (SEO and SXO landing page optimisation), Capital on Tap (growing SEO visibility using expert advice), Vonage (search rankings through SEO) and Gozney (non brand organic traffic, also brand, N3). Social and creators, N8: Moonpig (Instagram influencers for its gifting range), Teletubbies (viral moments on TikTok), Royal Air Maroc (influencer marketing for AFCON awareness, also N3) and Greenford Quay (always on social, also N3). AI and automation, N9: Mogo Farm, on the 942% LLM traffic case.

The other 9 are names only: Fresha, Pearl Yard Bermondsey, Fixter, Cosnova, Lovehoney, Preply, CloudZero, The AA and Remote are named without coded work; their need is inferred from the PR line it leads with.

Shared clients: Preply with jbh and junto, Moonpig with blue-array, The AA with msq.

What the base needs next: best placed for KJ8, human provenance becomes a distribution signal, driven by Creator & Influencer and Content & Digital PR, most exposed to KJ6, the agency middle is being hollowed out. It is likely, with moderate confidence, that its fintech and retail clients will keep buying earned coverage as a provenance signal, and likely, with low confidence, that they will push SEO and PR hours toward outcome pricing as KJ6 bites.
house: Say and do: 1 of 2 measurable lines is practised, house integrity 50. Creator & Influencer is corroborated, with own short form channels linked from its site, instagram and tiktok; AI Search / GEO is contradicted, it sells AI visibility and publishes no llms.txt, the one gap the Radar flags; Publishing cadence returned unknown, not measured, and the sitemap check returned 0 URLs, so content velocity is unrecorded rather than idle. No AI crawlers are blocked. The site runs on WordPress and Next.js with gtm, ga4, linkedin_insight, tiktok_pixel and hubspot as tags, the LinkedIn Insight and TikTok pixels as social pixels, no test tools and no ABM stack. Its Google Transparency Center record shows no ads, count 0. LinkedIn is active at a floor of 1+ company page ad out of 782 ads matching the name query; the sample reads 'AI search is changing how people discover brands, products and services'. Channels linked: LinkedIn, Instagram and TikTok.

The Monsoon read is 54.6, Breeze band, percentile 43, migration 53.1 against displacement 56.1, inferred, with no hub office or onshore claim listed. 53 of it is the sold mix, SEO (21) and Content & Digital PR (13) the most movable hours; the work would go 65% to South and Southeast Asia, 20% to Eastern Europe and 15% to Africa and the Maghreb.
openings:
The strongest opening is the say and do gap on its newest line: it sells GEO and AI search tracking, and its own site publishes no llms.txt, with P1 partial for want of an audited product and the sitemap check returning 0 URLs. It is very likely, with high confidence, that a rival who audits kaizen.co.uk's own machine readability leads with a finding it cannot answer; the falsifier is an llms.txt at the root before the next compile.

Contestable clients: Preply sits on the books of jbh and junto; Moonpig and The AA each sit on one other tracked book. The 9 names only accounts are where a rival asks what was delivered, since the record lists no pricing model, P5 unknown.

The offer that undercuts it is the one it does not sell: data and measurement scores 0 while KJ9 says measurement gets worse, so a rival bundling PR and SEO with attribution takes ground it has not claimed; P2 is absent, so feed, schema and entity work is unclaimed on a core search line. On price, displacement 56.1 makes an offshore undercut on SEO and PR hours roughly even chance to land, with low confidence.
